simple.meaning: חָלַף (châlaph) appears 28 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Leviticus, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 31:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָלַף (H2498) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חָלַף through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: חָלַף (châlaph) / H2498 is tracked through Genesis 31:7, Genesis 31:41, Genesis 35:2, Genesis 41:14. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
definitions.usage: abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.
definitions.full: H2498. chalaph חָלַף verb pass on or away , pass through (mostly in poetry) (Late Hebrew id., pass by or away, change ; Phoenician חלפת equivalent , Reinach RŠJ 1888, 276 ; Hoffm G. G. Abh. xxxvi. 1890, 20 ; Aramaic חֲלֵף pass away, change ; change, substitute ; Nabataean חלף change (?) Eut p. 53 ; Arabic come after, succeed, replace [compare 'Caliph' i.e. successor (of Mohammed)] and many derivatives Lane 792-799 ; so also ויחלפה MI 6 and his son succeeded him ; Ethiopic pass by, across, through ) — Qal Perfect חָלַף Song 2:11 ; Hab 1:11 etc.; Imperfect יַחֲלֹף Job 4:15 4 t.; 3 feminine singular suffix תַּחְלְפֵ֑הוּ 20:24 ; יַחֲלֹ֑פוּ Psa 102:27 ; Infinitive construct לַחֲלוֺף Isa 21:1 ; — 1. a. pass on quickly 1Sam 10:3 ; elsewhere only in poetry, move or sweep on , of a flood Isa 8:8 , or wind 21:1 ; Job 4:15 ; Hab 1:11 , of God Job 9:11 ; 11:10 . b. pass away ( vanish ) Job 9:26 (of days); Song 2:11 (of rain || עבר ), of the heavens Psa 102:27 , of idols Isa 2:18 , (but perhaps gloss JBL ix. 1890, 86 ). 2 of grass , come on anew , i. e. sprout again (compare Hiph`il 2 ) Psa 90:5 ; 90:6 , so Thes AV De Hi Che Bae and others; less suitably in context, ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Ew pass away , above 1b. 3. transitive a. pass through , i.e. pierce, followed by accusative Judg 5:26 ; Job 20:24 . b. overstep, transgress Isa 24:5 (|| עבר ), (compare Arabic IV. to break a promise). Pi`el Imperfect וַיְחַלֵּף ( cause to pass ) change , followed by accusative garment Gen 41:14 (E) 2Sam 12:20 . Hiph`il Perfect חֶחֱלִף Gen 31:7 ; Imperfect יַחֲלִיף Job 14:7 ; suffix יַחֲלִיפֶנּוּ Lev 27:10 ; 3 feminine singular תַּחֲלִיף Job 29:20 ; 2 masculine singular וַתַּחֲלֵף Gen 31:41 ; suffix תַּחֲלִיפֵם ; יַחֲלִ֑יפוּ Isa 40:31 ; 41:1 ; נַחֲלִיף 9:9 ; — 1 change (transitive) garments Gen 35:2 (E) Psa 102:27 , wages Gen 31:7 , 41 (both E); no object expressed Lev 27:10 (H); substitute i. e. cause to succeed Isa 9:9 ; change for better, renew , object כֹּחַ 40:31 ; 41:1 . 2 shew newness , of tree, putting forth fresh shoots Job 14:7 , of bow 29:20 . [ חֲלַף ] verb pass (over) (see Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al with יַל person pass over one (of time): Imperfect 3masculine plural יִחְלְפוּן Dan 4:13 , 20 , 22 , 29 .
